item.title: [ Map ] The Last Bullfight
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
⚠️ Important: This add-on only supports Survival and Versus Survival. It is not a campaign and does not support other game modes. Description In a Lima where people had begun to grow accustomed to living alongside the infection, a group of renegades, military deserters, politicians, and wealthy individuals turned the historic Plaza de Acho into the setting for a brutal underground spectacle, forcing people to fight infected in order to survive. The spectacle came to an end when an uncontrolled horde overran the arena and killed everyone inside. Now, the bullring remains abandoned, filled with corpses, scattered supplies, and traces of what happened there. The Last Bullfight is a Survival map for Left 4 Dead 2 inspired by the historic Plaza de Toros de Acho in Lima, Peru. The Survivors must withstand waves of infected inside the bullring, recreated with a nighttime atmosphere, custom lighting, custom infected, new content, and environments inspired by the real location. Developed by the independent Peruvian studio Galy Studio, the project aims to deliver an intense and localized Survival experience inspired by Peru. Additional Contributors Teph Castro "tephrda" — Level Design. Johan Yuffre — Visual Design and Promotion. Diir.lain — Modeling and Textures. Follow Games — Testing and Bug Fixing. Mallquiphotography — Testing and Bug Fixing. Chaos Kansei — Testing and Bug Fixing. Jean Carlos Luna (Tomatuv Games) — Testing and Bug Fixing. AstorMilanese — Low Poly Reflector. jQueary — Bell. Yorktown Font - Typographer Mediengestaltung — Typography Design. Special thanks to everyone who contributed during the development, testing, and release of the project. Usage and Permissions Redistribution, republication, extraction, modification, or incorporation of this content into other projects is not permitted without prior authorization from its authors. To request permission, create a translation, or use any resource from the mod, please contact the responsible author or team directly. Copyright © 2026 Galy Studio. Original resources created specifically for this project belong to their respective authors and contributors.
